skill_description: Carve items out of various materials, mostly wood and bones
required_items: (At least one) Any wooden object, such as tree branch, wooden rod, scrap wood, etc.
leveling: 1. (Level 0) (10 XP) Whittle sapling and tree branch into a long stick, then a spear
2. (Level 0) (5 XP) Carve tree branch into a stake
3. (Level 1) (60 XP) Whittle tree branch into a wooden rod, then wooden rod into 4 small handles, then small handles into wooden spoons
4. (Level 1) (30 XP) Carve scrap wood into 2 small handles, then turn small handles into 2 wooden spoons
5. (Level 2+) (140 XP) With 4 wooden spoons from each tree branch, carve each spoon into a wooden fork
6. (Level 2+) (20 XP) Carve a large branch into a plank
